title: Mobile phones and health
question: What health outcomes have been studied? Does call duration or technology matter?

title: Cordless and DECT phones
question: What is known about handset use and brain tumours? Is a DECT base station a separate exposure?

title: Wi-Fi and health
question: What evidence applies to routers and Wi-Fi devices? Does overnight exposure matter?

title: 5G and health
question: Which 5G bands have direct health research? What can older RF studies tell us?

title: Cell towers and base stations
question: How does ambient exposure differ from phone use? What health studies examine nearby residents?

title: Power lines and health
question: What exposure occurs near power lines? What is known about childhood leukaemia?

title: Smart meters and health
question: How often do meters transmit? Are meter-specific health outcomes studied?

title: Baby monitors and health
question: How do monitor types differ? What evidence directly concerns infants?

title: Bluetooth, earbuds, and wearables
question: What do these devices emit? Is there direct long-term health evidence?

title: Induction hobs and health
question: What exposures occur while cooking? What is known for pregnancy and implants?

title: Microwave ovens and health
question: What exposure occurs outside the oven? What do leakage measurements mean?

title: Electric blankets and health
question: What magnetic fields reach the body? Are pregnancy or cancer outcomes studied?

title: Electric vehicles and health
question: What fields occur in the cabin or while charging? Are health outcomes measured?

title: Household wiring and appliances
question: Which sources contribute to home ELF exposure? Can a device reading predict long-term exposure?

title: RF exposure at work
question: What differs for antenna, radar, and broadcast workers? What outcomes have been studied?

title: ELF exposure at work
question: How is workplace exposure measured? What do occupational cancer studies show?

title: MRI: static, gradient and RF exposures
question: How does MRI exposure differ from everyday RF? What safety questions concern patients and staff?

title: EMF and brain tumours
question: What is known for each tumour type? How do human and animal findings compare?

title: EMF and glioma
question: What do cohorts and case-control studies show? What about heavy use and latency?

title: EMF and meningioma
question: Is there an association? How well is long-term exposure measured?

title: EMF and acoustic neuroma
question: What do studies show for vestibular schwannoma? Do laterality and latency change interpretation?

title: EMF and childhood brain tumours
question: What do CEFALO and MOBI-Kids address? What remains unknown about lifetime exposure?

title: Magnetic fields and childhood leukaemia
question: What does residential ELF epidemiology show? Can it establish causation?

title: EMF and cancers beyond the brain
question: What evidence concerns blood, breast, liver, lung, or other cancers? Which findings are animal-only?

title: EMF and sleep
question: Does exposure affect sleep quality, sleep stages, or insomnia? Are blinded studies available?

title: EMF and male fertility
question: What happens to semen measures? Is conception or live birth studied?

title: EMF, female fertility, and pregnancy
question: Are fertility, miscarriage, or birth outcomes associated with exposure?

title: Electromagnetic hypersensitivity and symptoms
question: What symptoms do people report? What do blinded provocation studies test?

title: EMF and headaches
question: Is headache associated with exposure? Can experiments separate exposure from expectation?

title: EMF, attention, and memory
question: Are cognitive effects measured in blinded experiments? What about children?

title: EMF and DNA damage
question: What do cell and animal assays measure? Does a biomarker establish human disease risk?

title: RF exposure and tissue heating
question: How is heating measured? How do temperature, SAR, duration, and body size interact?

title: EMF and cancer in animals
question: What do lifetime bioassays and tumour-promotion experiments show? Are results replicated?

title: EMF and tinnitus
question: Is tinnitus incidence or severity associated with a defined exposure? Do blinded tests use validated outcomes?
